description: I feel boring because I have not traveled much.
My housekeeping is slightly messy and I feel a little embarrassed about it. I am not saying I am an inadequate person.
I feel embarrassed by my parents' manners at the table. I do not feel guilty about having that embarrassment.
I feel like a bad child for being embarrassed by my parents. It is my own embarrassment that I am judging.
I feel embarrassed when other people see how hard I am trying. I think of myself as a try-hard.
I have not learned to cook yet, so I asked a friend to show me. This is a practical skill gap and I do not feel bad about myself for it.
I deliberately lied so that a colleague was blamed for my mistake. I feel guilty about doing that, not about an ordinary need or characteristic.
There is something wrong with me, but I cannot identify any particular aspect or meaning.
